[USER] User asks about marine life one can expect to see in the Great Barrier Reef.  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] The Great Barrier Reef is home to a variety of marine life, including:  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 1. Various species of colorful fish such as clownfish, angelfish, and parrotfish  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 2. Turtles, including green turtles and loggerheads  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 3. Reef sharks, including whitetip, blacktip, and grey reef sharks  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 4. Larger marine animals such as humpback whales, minke whales, and dugongs  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] 5. Stunning coral formations, including staghorn, lettuce, and brain corals  
[ASSISTANT_SAID] There’s a chance to spot rare species such as the giant clam and the elusive nudibranch.
